response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_patient_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_of_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE UA >= 3.9 GROUP BY ID)

assumptions.assumption: AVG(APTT - PT) per patient ignores records where either APTT or PT is missing (the difference is NULL), so the difference average is over records with both values.
Patients whose per-patient average is NULL (e.g. no non-missing HGB) are ignored in the outer average for that column, so each outer average may be over a different set of patients.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute the average of APTT minus the average of PT per patient (each averaged over its own non-missing records) rather than the average of the per-record difference.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_patient_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt - avg_pt) AS avg_of_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT) AS avg_aptt, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA >= 3.9 GROUP BY ID)
